title: Brutality probe launched
subtitle: [Final C Edition]
article: The Williams Lake Indian band alleges that Paul Alphonse was the victim of excessive force by a patrol officer during an arrest April 11. Alphonse was arrested after a complaint of an intoxicated man passed out in front of a store.
RCMP are investigating the circumstances surrounding the "in custody" death Tuesday of a 67-year-old aboriginal man in Williams Lake.

The Williams Lake Indian band alleges that Paul Alphonse was the victim of excessive force by a patrol officer during an arrest April 11. Alphonse was arrested after a complaint of an intoxicated man passed out in front of a store. Police say Alphonse "became involved in an altercation with the arresting officer" while being booked into custody.

Alphonse was taken by ambulance to hospital about 20 minutes after he complained of chest pains. He was returned to jail about 6:15 p.m. but was taken back to hospital about 4 1/2 hours later after again complaining of chest pains.
He remained in Cariboo Memorial Hospital until his death Tuesday night.
Prince George and Kamloops Mounties will assist in the probe.
